name: Life spaceship ac1d0f14 on 2-uniform tiling k2-017
description: A period-4 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 2-uniform tiling k2-017, with touching neighbours, 6 to 9 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 8,192 rules from B3/S23 to B3,5,6,8,9,10,11,12/S1,2,3,7,9,10,11,12. It also runs in Life, unchanged, on k3-053. JETCARP's Life census met it in 76.3% of its soups on this tiling.
